name: Barbell high-bar back squat
definition: Stand with a barbell supported across the upper back in a high-bar position. Descend by flexing the hips and knees, then rise with the bar retained on the upper back.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Stand with a barbell supported across the upper back in a high-bar position.
value.movement: Descend by flexing the hips and knees, then rise with the bar retained on the upper back.
value.finish: Stand and return the bar to its supports when finished.
value.range_of_motion: Self-selected repeatable squat depth; no prescribed numerical knee or hip angle.
